CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Tempus is a technology company making precision medicine a reality through the practical application of artificial intelligence in healthcare. With one of the world's largest libraries of de-identified multimodal data and an intelligent operating system that makes that data accessible and actionable, Tempus connects AI, diagnostics and clinical workflows to deliver more personalized patient care and accelerate the discovery, development and delivery of better medicines. By continuously transforming data into insights, Tempus is building a learning healthcare ecosystem in which every patient can benefit from the treatment and experiences of those who came before.
